passages.heading: The core idea
passages.markdown: A mobile application that crashes or refuses to update can have several causes: insufficient storage, an unsupported operating system, a damaged local cache, or a connectivity problem. Record the application version, operating system version, error message, and recent changes. Check whether one application is affected or whether many applications show the same symptom. That distinction helps separate an application-specific fault from a wider device or network condition.

passages.heading: In the real world
passages.markdown: Start with low-impact checks such as available space, network access, and a supported application restart. Check for compatible updates through the approved source. Clearing cached temporary data is different from clearing all application data; the latter can remove local files, sessions, or settings. Before reinstalling or resetting, verify synchronization, backups, and any account recovery requirements. For battery drain, inspect usage by application and recent activity rather than assuming the battery hardware is faulty. After the change, repeat the affected workflow and confirm that important local content remains available.

passages.heading: Make it stick
passages.markdown: Put it into practice by explaining the decision in your own words. In a support scenario, identify the requirement first, connect it to the relevant technology, and check the result against that requirement. If the evidence changes, revisit your reasoning rather than repeating the same action. Document what you observed so the next person can understand your conclusion.

activities.prompt: Before clearing an application’s stored data, what should a technician verify?

options.text: Whether local content is backed up or synchronized
options.whyWrong: This connects the requirement with the appropriate concept.

options.text: That all user files are disposable
options.whyWrong: Application data can include valuable unsynchronized local content.

options.text: That the display brightness is maximum
options.whyWrong: Display brightness does not protect application data from removal.
